subject.title: Model configuration accepts unvalidated model names, enabling silent misconfiguration

question: Should unknown configured model refs be warning-only in doctor/config validate, hard validation errors, or handled only at startup/runtime when catalog authority is incomplete?
rationale: The source can enumerate configured refs, but the behavior affects custom providers, forward-compatible model names, fail-closed validation, provider routing, and upgrade safety, so maintainer product policy is required before a repair lane is safe.

options.title: Warning-first validation
options.body: Add catalog-backed warnings for unknown configured refs while preserving a documented path for custom and forward-compatible models.

options.title: Strict validation
options.body: Reject unknown configured refs at config validation time and accept the compatibility cost only with an explicit escape or migration contract.

options.title: Runtime-only handling
options.body: Keep config validation permissive and rely on startup checks, runtime errors, and fallback notices instead of a new config/doctor analyzer.

recommendation.title: Warning-first validation
recommendation.body: Add catalog-backed warnings for unknown configured refs while preserving a documented path for custom and forward-compatible models.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is the strongest observed owner across the current validation lines, configured-ref collector, doctor check, and model-catalog seams.
